methodology: Source: data/features.json fdr block per player (fdr_avg, dgw, next[] GW1-5). fdr_avg already applies an away-fixture penalty (+0.3 per away leg) baked into the weighted average, verified by manual recomputation matching the stored fdr_avg exactly for all 8 squad clubs. Lower fdr_avg = easier run. Ranked all 15 real-squad players' clubs (LIV, MCI, MUN, BRE, CHE, ARS, SUN, COV) by weighted next-5 fdr_avg.

best_runs.reason: Easiest weighted run of any squad club. Two fdr-2 fixtures (GW3 A, GW4 H) support both clean-sheet and attacking-return upside.
Two soft home fixtures (fdr 2, GW3/GW5) frame a single tough away (GW4, fdr 4). Strong differential/captaincy pool on the home weeks.
Best fixture cluster by squad-asset count — three starters including the captain. Soft opening double (fdr 2/2) backs the early-season armband choice; only GW4 home (fdr 4) is a concern.

worst_runs.reason: Hardest run in the squad — two away fdr-5 fixtures (GW1, GW3). All three assets are bench-only so limited live impact, but avoid using FH/bringing any COV player into the XI before GW2/GW4.
Only GW1 is soft; GW2 and GW3 both carry fdr 4. Partially offset by Saliba + J.Timber both confirmed OUT (news.json), which locks in nailed minutes for Gabriel/Calafiori despite the harder fixtures.

Tied-worst fdr_avg with ARS. Backloaded difficulty — GW5 away is the single hardest fixture (fdr 5) anywhere in the squad run. CHE (fdr_avg 3.18) is close behind and worth monitoring too given its GW3 fdr-5 spike.

dgw_alerts.detail: dgw:false confirmed in features.json for every squad club (ARS, BRE, CHE, COV, LIV, MCI, MUN, SUN) across GW1-5. No double-gameweek TC/BB planning trigger yet this early in the season.

bgw_alerts.detail: n_fixtures:5 confirmed for all 8 squad clubs — every club has exactly one fixture in each of GW1-5. Zero blank risk detected in the current data window.

rotation_risks.reason: Both ARS starting CBs, but Saliba and J.Timber are confirmed OUT (news.json, status INJURED, chance 0%) — reduces rotation risk despite the tougher GW2/GW3 fixtures.

injury_flags.impact: Back injury, unknown return — not in the real squad but thins ARS CB depth, benefiting Gabriel/Calafiori's minutes security.
Groin injury, unknown return — same effect, further secures Gabriel/Calafiori starts.

summary: GW1 (next-5 window GW1-GW5). Easiest weighted runs: LIV (Frimpong, fdr_avg 2.78), MCI (Semenyo, 2.92), MUN (Lammens/B.Fernandes-captain/Mbeumo, 2.98). Hardest: COV (bench-only assets, 3.58), ARS (Gabriel VC/Calafiori, 3.38, cushioned by Saliba+Timber both out), SUN (E.Le Fée/Hume, 3.38, backloaded to a brutal GW5 away fdr-5). No DGW and no BGW flagged for any squad club across GW1-5.
